battle.name: 西夏、吐蕃攻宋之戰
battle.brief: 西夏、吐蕃攻宋之戰是西夏與吐蕃聯軍在陝西大順城一帶對北宋發動的攻勢，雙方在宋夏邊境展開反覆攻守，宋軍依託堡壘、弓箭與地勢據守抵禦。與此同時，維京長斧（Dane axe）已在北歐列裝，作為步兵重斧用來破盾、砍擊披甲目標，並非宋軍本戰的現場裝備。

kit.name: 維京長斧
kit.history: 刃很長，斧面窄。北歐的船隊帶著它，也帶著它上岸。

countries: 這場戰役在宋人史料中，是元祐二年西夏與吐蕃諸部入寇的西北戰事；「西夏、吐蕃攻宋之戰」是方便後人概括的題名，並非當時一份有固定戰線的單一會戰。交戰三方為北宋、西夏與吐蕃諸部。戰區橫跨涇原、秦鳳與熙河：夏方主要威脅宋方在涇原、秦鳳的堡寨與後方糧道，吐蕃諸部則由河湟、熙州方向施壓，兩線在山地、溪谷與關隘間相連，但不必完全同步展開。平夏城及天都山一帶，是宋方前進堡寨與西夏控制區的交界，因此全役不是一次在平原正面排開的會戰，而是由攻堡、援城、野戰、追擊及重整堡寨串成的邊境戰役。吐蕃在十一世紀末早已分裂為不同政治與軍事集團，應保留宋籍所用的「吐蕃」名稱，但不能虛構一個統一的吐蕃帝國、一位全國君主或一套貫通的指揮系統。
countriesEn: In the Song records, this was a northwestern war in the second year of the Yuanyou reign, when Western Xia and Tibetan groups invaded Song territory. The title “Western Xia and Tibetan Attack on Song” is a convenient modern summary rather than the name of a single set-piece battle with one continuous front. The three belligerents were the Northern Song, Western Xia, and various Tibetan groups. The theater stretched across the Jingyuan, Qinfeng, and Xihe circuits. Western Xia principally threatened the Song fortified chain and supply routes in Jingyuan and Qinfeng, while Tibetan groups exerted pressure from the Huangshui and Xizhou direction. These theaters were connected by mountain tracks, river valleys, and passes, although the attacks did not always unfold simultaneously. The area around Pingxia City and Tiandu Mountain marked the boundary between Song’s forward fortifications and territory held by Western Xia. The campaign therefore consisted of attacks on forts, relief operations, field combat, pursuit, and the consolidation of the defensive line rather than one mass confrontation on an open plain. By the late eleventh century, the Tibetan polity had fragmented into distinct political and military groups. The Song designation “Tibet” can be retained, but no revived unified Tibetan empire, single national sovereign, or continuous command structure should be invented.
people: 宋方的政治中樞是年幼的宋哲宗趙煦與臨朝聽政的高太后；高太后主持的元祐朝廷把政策由神宗末年的大規模西北用兵轉為謹慎守邊與外交交涉，但在西北仍保留進取性的部署，實際的軍事中樞則落在負責西北經略的章惇手中。章惇需要統籌涇原、秦鳳、熙河各路兵、沿邊堡寨及後方援軍，不能把西北軍政理解成只由一支主力在同一處作戰。與元祐西北戰線相關的前線將領中，可由宋史列傳核實者包括郭成與折可適；但各人生平材料沒有留下兩人在此次戰役中每一日的行軍位置、隸屬縱隊及指揮交接，若硬排成同步的戰鬥次序，反而會把不同戰線拼成並未發生的場面。興慶府一方的西夏主是李秉常，號遵廉；宋籍可以確認夏方由其朝廷發動戰事，卻沒有保存一張可供核對的戰場指揮表。吐蕃方面同樣缺乏一位貫穿全軍的首領姓名，必須按不同部眾與各自首領處理。這場戰役的關鍵人物因而首先是宋方的章惇，以及西夏朝廷、吐蕃各部和宋方各路將領之間並不完全一致的決策鏈。
peopleEn: The Song political center consisted of the young Emperor Zhezong, Zhao Xu, and Empress Dowager Gao, who exercised regency authority. Her Yuanyou government shifted policy away from Shenzong’s late campaigns in the northwest toward defensive caution and negotiated border management, although it retained an activist military posture in the region. The practical military center was Zhang Dun, who administered northwestern operations. Zhang Dun had to coordinate troops from the Jingyuan, Qinfeng, and Xihe circuits, frontier garrisons, and reinforcements arriving from the rear; the northwestern command should not be imagined as a single field army fighting in one place. Song histories confirm prominent commanders associated with the Yuanyou northwestern theater, including Guo Cheng and Zhe Keshí. Their biographies do not, however, provide a verified daily itinerary, exact formation assignments, or chain of command for this particular campaign, so arranging them into one synchronized order of battle would create a scene that never existed. On the Western Xia side, the ruler was Li Bingchang, who used the reign title Zunlian. Song sources establish that the campaign was launched from the Xingqing court, but they do not preserve a checkable battlefield command chart. The Tibetan side likewise lacks one identifiable commander for the entire force; different contingents and their own leaders must be treated separately. The central figure is therefore Zhang Dun on the Song side, followed by the unequal decision-making structures of the Western Xia court, the Tibetan groups, and the various Song regional commands.
kits: 以一〇八七年為時間上限，宋軍可使用的戰具包括神臂弓、雙弓床弩與其他弩機，箭矢類則有普通箭矢及已在此前用於軍事的火箭；步兵防護可用札甲、鎖子甲、兜鍪、梟翎盾、長槊與直刀，騎兵和運載人員則依賴馬鞍、韁具與馬匹。宋軍沿線堡寨能夠設置鹿角、拒馬，攻城或攻營時則可調用撞車、巢車、望樓及砲車，後方以車輛和馭馬輸送糧秣、飼料與軍械。聯合進攻的夏方與吐蕃諸部同樣擁有弓、馬弓箭、長矛、刀、盾、兜鍪，以及皮甲或札甲等防護裝備；其中仍有較多騎兵，馬具是其作戰與轉移的重要裝備。以上各項均不是依戰後想像拼出的奇械，而是唐代以來已出現、至十一世紀仍在軍中使用的真實裝備，沒有一件需要借用十二世紀以後才出現的震天雷、霹靂炮或回回炮。不過，現存史籍沒有留下此役逐營的裝備清冊，因此不能斷言宋軍每一營都配有多少神臂弓，也不能把所有盾、弩和攻城器具同時塞進同一處交鋒；較可靠的寫法，是把這些裝備視為雙方在該年確實可能取得並使用的技術上限。
kitsEn: For a cutoff of 1087, Song forces could field the divine-arm bow, double-bow crossbows, and other crossbow mechanisms. Their missile types included ordinary arrows and incendiary arrows already employed in warfare before this campaign. Infantry could use lamellar armor, mail, helmets, owl-feather shields, long spears, and straight swords, while cavalry and transport personnel relied on saddles, bridles, and horses. Frontier forts could be protected with abatis and sharpened barriers, while battering rams, siege towers, observation towers, and stone-throwing carriages were available for assaulting fortifications or camps. Behind them, wagons and pack animals carried grain, fodder, weapons, and other supplies. The attacking Western Xia and Tibetan forces likewise possessed bows, horse bows, spears, knives, shields, helmets, and protective equipment such as leather or lamellar armor. Many of their fighters remained mounted, making horse equipment central to their operations. None of these are imaginary weapons reconstructed from later fantasy. Every item mentioned had appeared before the eleventh century and remained available in Song-era military use; the account does not rely on later technologies such as the thunder crash bomb, thunderbolt bomb, or Huihui cannon. The surviving records do not contain a unit-by-unit equipment inventory for this campaign, however. It is therefore unsafe to assign a precise number of divine-arm bows to every formation or to place every shield, crossbow, and siege device in the same engagement. These items are best treated as historically documented equipment that the opposing forces could actually obtain and employ in 1087.
tactics: 宋方不是單一軍團，而是由涇原、秦鳳、熙州的路軍、各堡寨守軍與後方調集的野戰部隊構成，章惇以西北經略的權力統籌它們；夏軍與吐蕃諸部的聯合也不是一條命令下的整齊軍隊，兩方在兵員、馬匹補給及目標上各有打算，會合關係並不牢固。戰役前段，進攻方在涇原、秦鳳與熙河方向輪番攻擊宋方堡寨、山口及道路守備點，企圖迫使宋軍把援兵分散到不同方向；宋方則利用城寨、鹿角、弩陣和既定糧道保持抵抗能力，不讓前線守軍離開堡寨後即失去補給。兩軍在野外接觸時，宋軍仍以弩兵限制接近路線，以持矛、持刀的步兵維持陣線，騎兵承擔側翼遮斷、追擊與掩護；這是其所屬部隊的基本分工，但史籍沒有保存某次箭雨、某次衝鋒或某名騎將率先突入的細節，可用來重建一場戲劇化的單次會戰。當其中一線的攻勢受挫，宋軍得以把野戰主力集中到另一方向，解除堡寨受圍，再在敵方退離補給線後有限追擊。追擊沒有被寫成跨越整片山地的大奔襲，因為宋軍仍受城寨、糧秣和傳報節奏約束。戰役末段，重點不是奪取西夏都城，而是守住平夏城等前進據點、恢復沿線巡邏，並迫使攻勢退回宋方原有防線。
tacticsEn: The Song force was not one army. It comprised regional troops from Jingyuan, Qinfeng, and Xihe, garrison detachments holding individual forts, and a field force assembled from the rear, all coordinated by Zhang Dun through the northwestern administration. The Western Xia and Tibetan participation was likewise not a single perfectly integrated army. Each side had separate priorities in manpower, horses, supply, and objectives, and their coordination was imperfect. During the opening phase, the attackers struck Song forts, passes, and route positions in the Jingyuan, Qinfeng, and Xihe theaters in succession, attempting to force Song to divide its relief forces. The Song used the forts, abatis, crossbow positions, and established supply lines to maintain resistance, preventing frontier detachments from operating beyond reach of provisions. In open-country contact, Song crossbowmen restricted the approaches, spearmen and sword infantry held the line, and cavalry performed flank protection, screening, and pursuit. These were the basic functions of the formations involved, but the records do not preserve a particular arrow shower, charge, or cavalry leader breaking first into the enemy line. No invented dramatic moment should be substituted for the missing detail. Once pressure failed in one sector, the Song could concentrate its field force against the other, relieve the threatened fort, and pursue the attackers only after they moved beyond their own supply reach. This pursuit was not an unrestricted sweep across the mountains, because the Song army remained bound by its forts, provisions, and communication system. In the closing phase, the objective was not to capture the Western Xia capital. It was to hold Pingxia City and other forward posts, restore frontier patrols, and push the attack back behind the existing Song defensive line.
data: 可核的時間骨架是：元祐元年（一〇八六），章惇主持西北經略，宋廷在秦鳳、涇原及熙河一線維持堡寨和援軍體系；元祐二年（一〇八七），夏方與吐蕃諸部入寇的軍報接連到達，宋方由守備、逐次解圍轉為集中反擊，年內再鞏固平夏城等前進據點。戰役前段是分散的堡寨攻防與道路爭奪，中段才形成涇原、秦鳳方向的野戰和對熙河一線的策應，末段則是有限追擊、恢復巡邏及重新配置守軍。它不是可以按一張戰圖辨認全部交鋒點的單日戰鬥，現存宋史摘要也沒有保存逐日的干支日期、各部番次、會合地點及完整行程，因此不能為湊出明確日程而虛構某月某日的一次會師。編制上可確認的是宋方以經略司統轄各路軍、堡寨守軍和後方援軍，夏方與吐蕃則由不同軍事集團分別投入。路線上，後方供應主要由渭州、秦州通向涇原、秦鳳前線，熙州則是另一側軍政與糧秣節點，前方運輸依靠車隊、馭馬及沿線屯糧，並受水源、溪谷和山口限制。弩矢、普通箭矢與火箭均屬可用軍需，但總數沒有留下來。主要依據是《宋史·哲宗本紀》《宋史·章惇傳》《宋史·夏國傳》《宋史·河湟吐蕃傳》及《續資治通鑑長編》所保存的概略；它們足以重建勝負、前後次序與戰略方向，不足以重建雙方總兵力、精確傷亡、被俘人數或逐日戰表。
dataEn: The verifiable chronological framework is as follows. In the first year of Yuanyou, 1086, Zhang Dun took charge of northwestern operations while the Song maintained forts and a relief system across Qinfeng, Jingyuan, and Xihe. In the second year, 1087, reports of Western Xia and Tibetan incursions reached the court. The Song moved from local defense and successive relief operations into concentrated counterattack, then consolidated forward positions such as Pingxia City before the year ended. The opening phase consisted of dispersed struggles over forts and roads, the middle phase of field operations in the Jingyuan-Qinfeng theater and supporting action in Xihe, and the closing phase of limited pursuit, restored patrols, and redeployment of garrisons. This was not a single-day battle whose every point of contact can be plotted on one map. Surviving Song summaries do not preserve daily cyclical dates, unit strengths, rendezvous sites, or a complete itinerary, so no precise schedule of meetings and clashes should be invented. The Song command structure can be confirmed at the level of the regional administration coordinating circuit troops, fort garrisons, and rear reinforcements; Western Xia and Tibetan forces entered through separate military groupings. For supply, the rear connection ran principally from Weizhou and Qinzhou toward the Jingyuan-Qinfeng line, while Xizhou served as an administrative and logistical node on the other side. Transport depended on wagons, pack animals, and grain deposited along the route, all constrained by water, valleys, and mountain passes. Crossbow bolts, ordinary arrows, and fire arrows were available, but their totals are not recorded. The main evidence consists of the outline preserved in the Zhezong Annals, the Zhang Dun biography, the Western Xia and Huangshui-Tibetan biographies of Song History, and the Xu Zizhi Tongjian Changbian. These sources support the result, sequence, and strategic direction, but not exact total strengths, precise casualties, prisoners, or a day-by-day order of battle.
cause: 戰爭的背景至少包含三層。第一層是宋夏長期邊爭留下的軍力與堡寨對峙：宋神宗在一〇八一年組織五路伐夏，此後戰事延續到元豐末年；宋廷後來停止大規模進攻，雙方進入交涉與重整邊界的階段，但西夏從未放棄對秦鳳、涇原方向戰略縱深的爭奪。第二層是宋廷最高政策轉變造成的邊界不確定性。神宗於一〇八五年去世，高太后臨朝，元祐朝廷一面收縮冒進，一面仍讓章惇維持西北軍政、推進前進堡寨；對西夏與河湟吐蕃諸部而言，宋方政策並非單一且立即可辨的全面退讓。第三層是地方權力與資源控制：吐蕃諸部受到宋軍此前經營熙河、奪取河州等地區的壓力，夏方則不願讓宋方堡寨繼續向西推進；不同部眾還涉及山路、馬場、堡寨及部眾歸附的競爭。現存史料沒有保存一封導火戰書，也沒有一項能解釋所有參戰者的單一事件，因此所謂「聯軍」應理解為在共同壓力宋方防線的目標下形成、但利益並不完全一致的行動，而不能視為西夏與一個統一吐蕃政權共同制定的一張完美計畫。
causeEn: At least three levels of background lay behind the war. First came the military and fortified standoff inherited from the long Song-Xia frontier conflict. Emperor Shenzong had organized the five-pronged campaign against Western Xia in 1081, and warfare continued into the final years of the Yuanfeng era. The Song later halted its large-scale offensives and moved toward negotiation and a new border settlement, but Western Xia did not abandon the strategic depth of the Qinfeng and Jingyuan approaches. Second was uncertainty created by a change in the highest Song policy. Shenzong died in 1085, and Empress Dowager Gao’s Yuanyou government reduced the danger of overextended campaigns while retaining Zhang Dun’s northwestern administration and forward fortification. To Western Xia and the Huangshui Tibetan groups, this was not a simple, immediate, and unmistakable full Song withdrawal. Third were local questions of power and access. Tibetan groups had been pressed by Song expansion in Xihe and the seizure of Hezhou, while Western Xia resisted the further westward advance of Song forts. Roads, pasture, fortified sites, and the allegiance of local communities also remained points of competition. The surviving sources preserve no single letter that triggered the war and no one incident explaining every participant. The “combined attack” should therefore be understood as an alignment of shared pressure against Song defenses among actors with partly divergent interests, not a perfect joint plan created by Western Xia and a unified Tibetan state.
impact: 最直接的影響，是宋方在元祐二年沒有因夏、吐蕃同時用兵而失去西北主防線，宋軍在守住既有城寨、完成反擊後，反而維持了涇原、秦鳳和熙河一線的部署主動。這並不是一次以大片土地換來的征服：平夏城等堡寨的重要性，在於控制山道、保護後方供應和限制西夏騎兵的活動，而不是畫出龐大的新領土。戰役也使章惇及其所轄秦鳳、涇原將領的聲望上升，元祐朝廷從而在「謹慎守邊」與「維持堡寨、反擊來犯」之間繼續反覆討論西北政策；章惇的勝利不能簡單等同於元祐朝廷已完全接受神宗式的大規模攻勢。從更長的時間看，這一輪戰事鞏固了以堡寨、糧道和經略司協調邊軍的防衛形態，也讓西夏與吐蕃諸部明白，宋方能夠把不同戰區的兵力和物資集中到同一方向。不過，元祐年間其後仍有西北衝突，顯示此次勝利不等於永久和平，更不等於雙方矛盾已獲政治解決。關於戰役造成的死亡、俘虜及後方消耗，史料同樣沒有留下可靠總數，不能用修辭性的「斬獲甚眾」代替數字。
impactEn: The most immediate effect was that the Song did not lose its principal northwestern defensive line when Western Xia and Tibetan groups applied pressure at the same time. After holding the established forts and mounting a counterattack, the Song retained control of its deployments across Jingyuan, Qinfeng, and Xihe. This was not a conquest purchased by the annexation of vast territory. Pingxia City and the other forts mattered because they commanded mountain routes, protected rear supply, and restricted the movement of Western Xia cavalry, not because they enclosed an enormous new province. The campaign also raised the political and military standing of Zhang Dun and the commanders serving in Qinfeng and Jingyuan. The Yuanyou court consequently continued debating northwestern policy between defensive caution and the maintenance of forts and counterattacks; Zhang Dun’s success cannot simply be equated with a wholesale return to Shenzong’s grand offensives. Over the longer term, the conflict reinforced a frontier system based on forts, supply routes, and coordination through the regional administration. It also showed Western Xia and the Tibetan groups that the Song could concentrate troops and materiel from separate theaters against a shared frontier. Later conflicts during the Yuanyou years demonstrate that this victory did not create permanent peace or resolve the underlying political disputes. The sources likewise preserve no reliable total for deaths, prisoners, or rear-area costs, so rhetorical phrases about vast kills cannot replace figures.
result: 若按此役的直接軍事目的判定，結果是宋軍獲勝，但應把「勝」限定在實際可核的範圍內。夏方與吐蕃諸部的進攻未能突破宋方在涇原、秦鳳及熙河的主要堡寨線，攻勢受挫後，章惇得以集中兵力反擊、解除部分受威脅的據點，年內再鞏固平夏城等前進位置。這不是對西夏或吐蕃的決定性消滅：聯合行動者沒有遭到全滅，戰場上的精確傷亡、俘獲總數及雙方總兵量均未留下可核記錄；宋方也沒有藉此攻入興慶府或取得足以改變西北版圖的大片土地。現存這組戰事摘要亦未把一份正式和約列為其直接結果，因此不宜附會出一場同時解決外交問題的會盟。可以確認的是，宋方守住了既有邊防骨架，迫使進攻者退離主要戰線，並在戰後仍握有堡寨與後方道路的主動。這是一場以防衛、反擊和局部追擊完成的有效西北戰役，意義在於邊境部署沒有崩潰，而不是一場決定兩國長期命運的總決戰。
resultEn: Judged by the campaign’s immediate military objectives, the result was a Song victory, but the meaning of that victory must remain within what can actually be verified. The offensive by Western Xia and the Tibetan groups failed to break the Song’s main fort line across Jingyuan, Qinfeng, and Xihe. After the assault was checked, Zhang Dun could concentrate his forces, counterattack, relieve threatened positions, and consolidate forward works such as Pingxia City before the year ended. It was not a decisive destruction of Western Xia or Tibetan forces. The participants were not annihilated, and no reliable totals survive for battlefield casualties, prisoners, or the respective strengths of the armies. The Song did not penetrate the Western Xia capital at Xingqing or acquire territory large enough to redraw the northwestern map. The surviving summaries of this particular campaign also do not list a formal treaty as one of its direct results, so a diplomatic settlement should not be invented for it. What can be confirmed is that the Song preserved its established defensive framework, forced the attackers away from the principal front, and retained control of the forts and rear roads afterward. It was an effective northwestern campaign completed through defense, counterattack, and limited pursuit. Its significance lay in the survival and consolidation of the frontier deployment, not in a single conclusive battle deciding the future of two states.
